title: Skills & MCP connections
intro: An owned bundle for this agent key. Skills are plain instructions and reference text included in the actual canvas review and execution.
skill_help: Up to 8 skills, 4,000 bytes per instruction or resource, 12,000 bytes combined. The full reviewed prompt is limited to 16,000 bytes. Empty skills are omitted; clear all fields to remove one. No files, URLs or scripts are imported or executed.
name: Skill name
mcp_help: Attach up to 8 existing site connection profiles. A discovery result verifies only the last discovery of that configuration, not current availability or tool safety. These references do not automatically execute tools.
missing: An attached profile was removed or is invalid. Review the selections; saving omits missing references.
changed: Configuration changed: review and save to rebind
no_mcp: No MCP connection profiles are available.
external: External clients must stay connected and polling. Configure MCP credentials and permissions in that client. Managed text execution applies skills; tools require a separate reviewed policy and approval for each exact call.
review: I reviewed these instructions and references. Saving retires existing recurring and incoming-event consent and requires a fresh canvas review.
saved: Bundle saved. Review affected canvas actions again before running.
invalid: The bundle is invalid or a profile/agent changed. Check the limits and reload before trying again.
conflict: The saved bundle changed in another session. Reload and review before saving.
